articles.summary: The Indian government has raised the windfall tax (SAED) on diesel exports to ₹14 per litre and on aviation turbine fuel (ATF) exports to ₹12.5 per litre, while keeping petrol export duty unchanged at ₹1.5 per litre from June 16, to secure domestic fuel availability amid West Asia tensions and rising global crude prices.
